Agent 21/35 — TCS interaction with lateral tire demand. Test SPORT/FULL/OFF at 50–120 km/h corner exit with the new digital steering envelope. Measure intervention timing, wheel slip, front/rear lateral utilization and yaw. Find whether TCS cuts or reapplies torque in a way that produces artificial push or oscillation. Do not change grip or steering to accommodate TCS. Patch only if control logic is demonstrably wrong.
